_note: Intra-Germanic blend (continental Germanic + Frankish): an Alemannic confederation of forest-and-hill cantons, kin-reiks bound by the thing, pressed against the Frankish world. Backbone = Gothic/continental Germanic (phonology, reiks/thiudans clan ladder); overlay = Frankish/OHG (the High-German shift in some words, the Herizogo dukes, -ingen lineages, vineyards). clan = clanhold. Even split Lawful/Neutral. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Gothic/Frankish register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Gothic-branch reflexes (with Frankish-overlay variants) of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json), phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic gods.

phonology.palette: Gothic/continental Germanic backbone (masc -s/-a, fem -o; th/dh, w; ai/au) with Frankish/OHG overlay touches (High German shift in some words, -ingen lineages); theophoric stems are the Gothic reflexes (Thulrs-, Erlanda-, Numins-) with Frankish variants (Dulro-, Erlant-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clusters (st, sk, hl, hr, hw, br); root-initial stress; ablaut.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -sunus / -ing (descendant of); kin (kuni) for nobility; Frankish-overlay -ingen lineages for the duke-houses.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (an Alemannic confederation of kin-reiks and cantons; the thing/gemot binds the dukes, with Frankish herizogo/grafio forms as overlay)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Gothic clanhold backbone, ascending, with Frankish overlay at the count/duke tiers (the Alemannic Herizogo). Gardings (household-lord) barony; Markareiks (march-ruler) march; Grafio (count, Frankish) county; Herizogo (duke, Frankish) duchy; Reiks (great ruler) principality; Thiudans (people-king) kingdom. A confederation rarely rises past the duchy in practice. (Rank titles are the real Gothic/Frankish register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + -sunus patronymic or kin (kuni); Frankish-overlay -ingen lineages for the duke-houses; deed-bynames.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the reiks- and herizogo-houses carry a lineage name; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names from the Gothic deity-reflexes (with Frankish-overlay variants) + an element: -mers (famous), -reiks (ruler), -berht (bright, Frankish overlay): e.g. Thulra-mers, Erlanda-berht.

religion._note: Deity-names are the Gothic-branch reflexes of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json), with Frankish-overlay variants - phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic gods. Lawful/Neutral henotheist: the One above His ministers; Neutral kin keep the Anses (ancestral dead) and the saints at the grove and the minster.
religion.the_one: Aiterns (< *Aiternaz < Aeternus; the high All-Father; the Frankish-touched say Aiterno)
religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the opposing powers keep their Gothic reflexes + a portfolio epithet (distinct per power): Maraxus -> Marahs the War-Fire (Frk. Marach); Vacidus -> Wakiths the Unmaker; Lusanto -> Lusanths the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Alhs (sacred grove) or Munstar (minster, Frankish overlay) of [power]: 'the Alhs of Erlands'.
religion.saints_pattern: the Anses (deified forebears) at the grave-howe and grove; the Frankish-touched keep saints (Wih [name]) at the minster.

holy_symbol_motifs.Erlands: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring
holy_symbol_motifs.Thulrs: a rayed sun-wheel above the scales

banks_patterns.ships: (inland confederation) river-craft and wagon-names: 'the Aurochs', 'Boar of the Ahwa'
banks_patterns.military_units: the [kin] War-band (harjis) / the [canton] Spears: 'the Forest-Spears', 'the Wolf-harjis'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen kin-burgs and grove-howes: 'the Howe of [name]', 'the broken Burg of [kin]'
